title: narcissus tazetta subsp. cupularis
intro: Narcissus tazetta subsp. cupularis, commonly known as Chinese sacrifice, is a type of plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Chinese sacrifice are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative and an expectorant, promoting relaxation and the release of mucus. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
